stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.
